pages.text: Staff climb by tasks: $(l)Intern$(), $(l)Associate$() at 50, $(l)Senior Associate$() at 300, $(l)Team Lead$() at 1,000. A grade takes effect at a $(l)Performance Review$(), never by itself.

When the tasks are there, the Roster says "Review due". Press $(l)Review$() on its line with Paper in your inventory: one sheet becomes the slip, and the grade jumps to the highest the tasks earn.$(br2)+5 morale, once a day.

Associate: 10%% faster, 3 filters a stop$(br)Senior: 20%% faster, 6 filters, carries half again$(br)Team Lead: 30%% faster, 9 filters, carries half again, two wages a dawn, a tie; staff within 8 blocks work 10%% faster
pages.title: Form 50-G: Grades

pages.text: The slip: tasks since the last review, days unpaid, grievances, strengths, areas for growth, a rating. A Grievance since the last review means a Performance Plan, whatever else it did.$(br2)Interns never strike.$(br2)$(o)Areas for growth: hands.$()
